reviews.text:
We love this shop! We bought two high-quality handmade beds, and after trying out the bathing area with Django and Koko, we love it even more. The value for money is unbeatable. The facilities are superbly equipped, spacious, and spotlessly clean. They have everything you need for bathing: soap, towels, combs… and it's also perfectly adapted for large dogs, with steps so they can easily get into the tub.

They have a wide variety of products, and the service is excellent: they're always incredibly friendly, kind, and attentive. Plus, every time we go to buy food or other things for the dogs, they give them a little something extra. 🥰

Without a doubt, a trustworthy shop that we'll keep coming back to.
I've been buying here for a while, but what I really want to highlight is the customer service... excellent service and prices.
Thank you very much, Ricardo!
Thanks for the stars, Paula! It really helps to give visibility to our project :)
Thank you so much for your feedback, Ivan!
The best pet shop in Nou Barris, without a doubt
I love the service and the place is great. I had my dog ​​bathed there and he was great.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Felipe!

I couldn't be happier!!!
They always recommend the best, the service is top-notch, and the products are high quality.
In my case, my dog ​​(Dark) has had digestive problems for a long time, and after countless veterinary tests, they've finally found the right food and probiotics!
I recommend them 100%!
Thanks for your feedback, Jesús! We're looking forward to showing you the improvements from our pet shop renovation :D
Thanks Catherine!

A COMPLETE FIND! While searching for Ownat cat food, I stumbled upon this gem of a neighborhood shop 😌 I must say, I was delighted with the HUGE VARIETY of healthy food they have for our furry friends. So, I went ahead and placed my order there. The shop owner is so kind, empathetic, and friendly 💕 She was incredibly patient; I'm a bit of a cat food geek! And the best part is that they deliver (her husband does it and he's very kind). I didn't know that, so she let me know they could bring it to my house—AMAZING! They take orders via WhatsApp, and if you need something specific, they'll bring it right to your door, and you can pay by card too. Honestly, I'm sticking with them. 💚💕😌👑 Thank you guys, you're the BEST!
Thank you so much for your review, Estrella.
Hi Marta! Thank you for your feedback.
Thank you so much, Emi!

Specialty pet food store. They have everything. Home delivery available. Very close to Roquetes station on line 3 of the Barcelona metro. Excellent customer service, professional and friendly. A visit is recommended.
Variety of products and good service
Excellent service, great value for money, friendly, caring, and wonderful people. Highly recommended.
Thanks for your feedback, Gines!

I've been shopping there practically since they opened, and the service has always been fantastic. They pamper my dog ​​Zero like she's their own, and they've always been there for me whenever I've needed help. I'm so glad I found them.
